what_happened: All five result clusters were machine-checked sorry-free with lean_run_code before planning: prop:nomic-tense-free (satSet bridge + collapse), thm:nomic-uniform (full (1)(2)(3)=>(5), (5)=>(4)=>(1)(2)(3), (5)<=>(6)), app:nomic-four both directions including the always/next countermodel, seriality (D), and the cut rmk:nomic-uniform side lemma. Measured axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] throughout.

Semantics/TruthClauses.lean's abstract clause layer (TruthEnv, BoxClause, UntlClause, StabClauses) is hard-bound to TaskFrame/WorldHistory/TaskModel and cannot be instantiated for a truth recursion whose evaluation world is a bare function in H_F over a NomicFrame. Nine derived-operator clause lemmas (neg, and, iff, someFuture, allFuture, somePast, allPast, always, next) must be re-derived natively in the nomic component; each is 3-8 lines and all nine were probed.

lean_run_code reported 'unknown namespace FormalSystem.Syntax' and an unknown NomicFrame for 'import FormalSystem.Semantics.Nomic' on the first attempt, although the aggregator and every olean under Semantics/Nomic/ were present and current. The identical import succeeded on retry later in the same session. Treat such a failure as transient LSP/olean warming, not as a missing aggregator.

Concurrent task 801 declares a file_scope containing docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md, README.md, FormalSystem/README.md, docs/reference/API_REFERENCE.md and typst/generated/status.typ. This task's gate set requires edits to the first four (C15 anchor rows for thm:nomic-uniform / app:nomic-four / rmk:nomic-uniform, and the regenerated inventory counts) and a regenerated typst/generated/status.typ. The implementation must re-read each file immediately before editing and stage only its own hunks.

Research report's concurrency risk row names task 801's file_scope as the collision source, but this dispatch's territory block names siblings 797 (plan, no declared scope) and 802 (research, 36-file scope). The overlap set changed: 802 claims docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md (this task needs it), docs/theorem-index.md (made a Non-Goal) and FormalSystem/README.md (readme-lint check 2, not gated). Plan was written against the dispatch's territory, not the report's.

Research closed all six deliverables sorry-free in nine lean_run_code probes against the built project, with measured axiom sets per result. Planning reduced to siting, naming and phase sequencing; no design question was left open for the implementer.

Two plan-time corrections to carried research recommendations: (a) the report's n-prefixed derived-operator names (nneg/nand/nalways/nnext) were probe artifacts for a single snippet; house style across Formula/OpenFormula is dotted names inside the type namespace, so NomicFormula.neg/.and/.always/.next. (b) NomicHierarchy.F3 is a plain def, so [F3.IsRegular] does not synthesize; the pinned app:nomic-four invalidity statement uses nomic_hierarchy's existential-with-bundled-instance shape instead.

Phase 1 (record rows first) makes C12 transiently red: the five new/repointed rows in docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md name Lean files (Uniformity.lean, NomicTruth.lean, NomicTenseFree.lean, NomicFour.lean) that Phases 2-7 have not created yet, and C12 resolves slash-shaped source paths in docs/. Self-resolving once Phase 7 lands; the plan's rows-before-docstrings ordering trades a transient C12 red for C15 greenness.

All six new Lean modules (Uniformity, Formula, NomicTruth, NomicTenseFree, NomicValidity, NomicFour) compiled green on the FIRST build attempt each, zero sorry and zero linter warnings against the repository's zero warning budget. The research report's nine compiled probes plus the plan's three measured linter traps (change-not-show, no no-op congr 1, simp-not-simpa) and two deprecation spellings (push Not, LE.le.ssubset_of_ne) meant the implementation was transcription rather than proof discovery.

check-metalogic-cycles.sh assertion B now FAILS with one SURPLUS upward edge, FormalSystem.MinusLanguage.AxiomDischarge -> FormalSystem.Theorems.LinearityDerived. Pre-existing and outside this task's file set: the import was added by commit ba6c0f5dd (task 788) without extending the 7-line allowlist in check-metalogic-cycles.sh, and AxiomDischarge.lean now carries 8 Theorems imports. It was MASKED until this task: without a NomicLanguage row in LANGUAGE_FILE_LAYERS, assertion B aborted early on the unlayered new directory and never reached the allowlist comparison. Reported, not repaired, per the plan's Phase 7 instruction on findings outside this task's own files; the fix is one allowlist entry owned by task 788.

C34 FAILED on a docstring-PHRASING collision, not a constraint error: its extractor is re.compile(r'Constraints consumed:\\s*([^\\n]*)') and matches the literal token anywhere in a declaration's /-- block, so the sentence 'It consumes no constraint, so it carries no `Constraints consumed:` line.' -- written precisely to document the ABSENCE of a marker on the two choice-free declarations nomic_iff_box_of_uniform and transAt_of_pointUniform -- parsed as a marker whose vocabulary is the word 'line.'. C34a and C34b both passed in the same run (82 markers honest, no unmarked binder-carrying declaration reads as a claim), which is the evidence the substantive claims were sound. Fix: reword to 'carries no constraints-consumed marker' (no colon, so outside the regex). Generalizable: prose that names a marker token verbatim collides with any extractor that greps for that token.
